security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU's riscv_cpu_do_interrupt() in cpu_helper.c writes the raw untransformed guest virtual address (env->badaddr) to stval/mtval during exception delivery without calling adjust_addr() to apply pointer masking transformation first, even when PMM is enabled for the trapping privilege mode. The spec norm:pm_csr_hw_apply requires that pointer masking be applied when hardware writes the faulting address to stval on exception. Additionally, debug address trigger matching in debug.c applies no pointer masking transformation, violating norm:pm_debug_trigger.
security_spec.summary: Exception delivery stores raw tagged address to stval/mtval instead of pointer-masked transformed address, leaking pointer tags to guest exception handlers and breaking HWASAN-style security tooling under emulation
